Honorific Class

  • CURIE: gmeow:HonorificClass
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/HonorificClass
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/names
  • Box roles: TBox role (What is this?)

The domain of an honorific (academic, clerical, noble, military, judicial, social).

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:HonorificClass as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use as the open value vocabulary for the social/institutional domain an honorific is drawn from (academic, clerical, noble, military, judicial, social) — referenced from gmeow:honorificClass on a gmeow:Honorific.

Avoid when

  • Avoid minting a Honorific subclass per class (classes are individuals) and avoid using it for render placement — that is gmeow:HonorificPosition.

How to use

  • Reference a seeded HonorificClass individual from gmeow:honorificClass on a Honorific; extend with a new individual rather than a subclass when a new domain of address appears.

Examples

  • ex:honorific gmeow:honorificClass gmeow:honorificClassAcademic.
